entries.message: its {part} is in a different root from the control, so it was not wired: an id reference cannot cross a shadow boundary.
entries.fix: Put the part and the control in the same root.

entries.message: its {part}'s id holds whitespace, so it cannot be one token of aria-describedby or aria-labelledby, and was left out.
entries.fix: Give the part an id without spaces, or none and labeled will give it one.

entries.message: the control has no accessible name after wiring: no label, no wrapping <label>, and no aria-label, aria-labelledby or title.
entries.fix: Hand labeled a label, or name the control yourself.
